packageRules.description: Exclude all @assistant-ui packages from automated updates
Keep Lexical aligned with @assistant-ui/react-lexical until the adapter supports newer releases
Group Sentry packages so @sentry/react and @sentry/electron are always bumped together. They share a @sentry/core peer and split installs cause duplicate-module type errors.
Update all bundled Kilo CLI platform packages together for manual compatibility testing.
Automatically merge minor and patch updates for GitHub Actions.
Ensure lock file maintenance PRs are never throttled

lockFileMaintenance.description: Regenerate pnpm-lock.yaml. Manual merge: native addons (electron, better-sqlite3, keytar) can break on lockfile-only bumps.
